manual.title: Keysight Trueform Series Operating and Service Guide (covers 33500B and 33600A Series)

transport.terminator: LF (binary block may be terminated by LF or EOI, per DATA:ARB example)
transport.notes: Manual: 'The instrument uses LAN port 5024 for SCPI Telnet sessions, and port 5025 for SCPI Socket sessions' (p.387, p.398, p.454).

reset.notes: Reset instrument to factory defaults. *CLS clears status (p.306).

clear_waveform_memory.notes: Required before re-using an arb name: 'Specifying a waveform that is already loaded generates a "Specified arb waveform already exists" error.' (p.251)

select_channel.command: SOURce1: | SOURce2: prefix, e.g. SOUR2:FUNC SIN
select_channel.notes: Channel selected by the [SOURce[1|2]:] and OUTPut[1|2] numeric suffix.

set_sample_rate.notes: 1 µSa/s to 250 MSa/s (33500 Series, as printed in the manual); limited to 62.5 MSa/s if FUNCtion:ARBitrary:FILTer is OFF. Example: FUNC:ARB:SRAT 1e4. Advance method: FUNCtion:ARBitrary:ADVance {TRIGger|SRATe} (p.283).

upload_waveform_float.notes: Float values -1.0 to +1.0; binary block = 32-bit floats (4 bytes/point). Example: DATA:ARB myArb, #236<36 bytes of your_binary_data><PMT>. Binary block: 8 to 1M or 16M samples per waveform depending on model/options; comma list 8 to 65,536 points. 33500 Series: 1 MSa or 16 MSa per channel depending on model/options.

upload_waveform_dac.notes: 16-bit integers; binary/list range -32,767 to +32,767 ('DAC codes go from -32,768 to +32,767'); +/-32767 correspond to peak values at offset 0 (10 Vpp -> +/-5 V). 2 bytes/point. <arb_name>: unquoted string up to 12 characters.

byte_order.notes: NORMal (default) = MSB first; SWAPped = LSB first ('Most computers use this').

select_waveform.notes: Selects an arb previously loaded with DATA:ARBitrary or MMEMory:LOAD:DATA[1|2]. Then FUNCtion ARB to play.

set_amplitude_vpp.notes: Units per VOLTage:UNIT; displayed value depends on OUTPut:LOAD.

set_output_load.notes: 1 Ω to 10 kΩ, default 50 Ω; OUTP:LOAD INF = high-Z (query returns 9.9E+37). Changes displayed values only, not actual output voltage.

external_10mhz_ref.notes: EXTernal uses rear-panel 10 MHz In; error if absent/unlocked. ROSCillator:SOURce:AUTO {ON|OFF} (default ON) prefers 10 MHz In; explicit ROSC:SOUR sets AUTO OFF. ROSCillator:SOURce:CURRent? returns INT/EXT.

trigger_slope.notes: Slope at rear-panel Ext Trig connector.

burst_cycles.notes: 1 to 100,000,000 or INFinity. For arbs, one 'cycle' = one pass of the waveform (BURSt:PHASe 0 = first point, p.241).

burst_state.notes: Enable after configuring other burst parameters. Continuous mode = BURSt:STATe OFF.

query_errors.notes: Reads and clears one error from error queue.

manual.source: university mirror (RPI) of the Keysight PDF. The separate 53220A/53230A Programmer's Reference was not found.

configure_time_interval.notes: channel(s): (@1),(@2)|(@2),(@1)|(@1)|(@2). Example: CONF:TINT (@1), (@2). Also MEASure:TINTerval? [<channel_pair>]. Defaults: auto-level 50 %, positive slope.

trigger_level.notes: Syntax continues {<volts>|MINimum|MAXimum|DEFault} per manual; LEVel1 = start, LEVel2 = stop threshold. Examples: INP:LEV1 1.0 ; INP:LEV2 1.0 (p.105). Auto/relative: INPut[{1|2}]:LEVel[{1|2}]:AUTO {OFF|ON|ONCE} (p.142); INPut[{1|2}]:LEVel[{1|2}]:RELative {<percent>|...} (p.143).

single_reading.notes: Example sequence on p.104/105 ends with READ?.

fetch_readings.notes: After INIT; transfers all readings (TRIG:COUN x SAMP:COUN); REAL data preceded by indefinite-length block header. R? [<max_count>] reads and erases (definite-length block); DATA:REMove? <count>[,WAIT].

reading_format.notes: ASCII: comma-separated, 15 significant digits (e.g. +4.57538162393720E+006), 23 bytes/reading. REAL: IEEE 754 64-bit, 8 bytes/reading. Default ASCII after *RST.

query_errors.notes: Shown in example '// read the error queue'; full syntax in the Programmer's Reference (not obtained).

manual.title: Model SR620 Universal Time Interval Counter Operation and Service Manual

transport.terminator: Commands: <cr> or <lf> on RS-232; <lf> or EOI on GPIB. Responses: <cr><lf> on RS-232 (changeable with ENDT), <lf>+EOI on GPIB.
transport.notes: RS-232 300 to 19.2 kBaud; front-panel default 'rS 232 bAud 9600' (p.17). Data bits/parity set in CTRL menu. No network port (RS-232/GPIB only). Commands: four-letter mnemonic + args.

configure_time_interval.notes: MODE(?) j: 0=time, 1=width, 2=tr/tf, 3=freq, 4=period, 5=phase, 6=count. Set other parameters after changing mode.

arming_mode.notes: 0 = +- time, 1 = + time, ... 6 ext trig +- time, 7 ext trig + time, 8 ext gate/trig holdoff, ...

trigger_level.notes: Set channel i threshold to x volts (remote only; turns off autolevel). Query returns 2 decimals. i=1 is channel A per the TERM example; index values for EXT/B not stated explicitly in extracted text (unverified). Autolevel: TMOD(?) i{,j}.

trigger_slope.notes: For EXT, A and B inputs: j = 0 positive, 1 negative.

input_impedance.notes: j = 0 50 Ohm, 1 1 MOhm, 2 UHF prescaler (freq/period only). Example: TERM 1, 1 sets A input to 1 MOhm.

external_10mhz_ref.notes: CLCK 0 = internal, 1 = external; CLKF 0 = 10 MHz, 1 = 5 MHz.

n_readings.notes: Number of samples per measurement (statistics over N).

start_measurement.notes: Same as front-panel START; STOP resets. AUTM(?) j: 0 = off recommended for computer control.

single_reading.notes: Starts a measurement, returns when complete; j=0 mean, 1 jitter, 2 max, 3 min.

fetch_readings.notes: XAVG? mean of last measurement (float, up to 16 digits); XALL? returns mean,rel,jitter,max,min comma-separated. Raw per-sample stream: BDMP j (GPIB only, 1 to 65535 points, 8-byte 2's-complement integers, LSB first; Time scale factor (2.712673611111111 E-12)/256 ≈ 1.05963812934 E-14 s, p.34).

frequency_measurement.notes: GATE: 1 ms to 500 s in 1,2,5 sequence; negative x = externally triggered gate. SRCE(?) j selects source (0=A, 1=B, 2=REF, 3=ratio).

query_errors.notes: Reads the error status register (or bit j). EREN sets enable; STAT? reads TIC status register.

manual.title: Programmer's Handbook, Timer/Counter/Analyzers CNT-90, CNT-91, CNT-91R, CNT-90XL ('9X')
manual.source: vendor (pendulum-instruments.com, linked from the CNT-91 product page). Note: manuals.pendulum-instruments.com 'Pendulum_Programmers_Handbook.pdf' (rev. 6) covers CNT-102/104 and FTR-210R, NOT CNT-91.

transport.terminator: IEEE 488.2 program/response message terminators (NL/^END); see ch.3
transport.notes: GPIB and USB (USBTMC/USB488; VID 0x14EB, PID 0x0090, e.g. USB0::0x14EB::0x0090::991234::INSTR, p.1-6). No LAN socket in this handbook. The manual's '8' glyph denotes a space.

configure_time_interval.notes: Generic form :CONFigure :<Measuring Function> [<parameters>[,(<channels>)]] (p.8-28); first channel = start, second = stop; (@1)=A, (@2)=B. Also :MEASure:TINTerval? (p.8-70) and :FUNC 'TINT 1,2' (SENSe tree p.8-98).

trigger_level.notes: -5 V to +5 V (2.5 mV steps) at 1X attenuation; setting a level turns off autotrigger. Example :INP2:LEV 2.0. Auto: :INPut«[1]|2»:LEVel:AUTO «<Boolean>|ONCE».

n_readings.notes: Measurements per INIT = ARM:COUN x TRIG:COUN.

fetch_readings.notes: ARRay max 10000 (MAX = all, CNT-91 only); negative size fetches last N.

reading_format.notes: ASCII <Val> or <Val>,<TS>; REAL #18<Val> (double); PACKed #216<Val><TS> (TS int64 ps). *RST ASCii, BORDer NORMal.

gate_time.notes: 20 ns to 1000 s; *RST 10 ms. Frequency: :CONF:FREQ or :MEASure:FREQuency? (p.8-60).

missing: TCP port (no LAN interface in this handbook)

manual.title: TICC Timestamping Counter Operation Manual
manual.source: vendor (TAPR; linked from tapr.org/manuals and the TICC product page)

transport.terminator: Output lines terminated with carriage return and linefeed; 7-bit ASCII. Config input lines terminated with carriage return.
transport.notes: USB serial emulation, default 115200 8N1; baud settable in 2025 firmware (230400 needed for max rate). Not a SCPI device.

output_format_timestamp.notes: Timestamp mode: each value followed by channel ID (default names A/B -> chA/chB; settable with F <x>/<y>). Units seconds; default 11 decimal places (10 ps), settable 0-12. Strict ascending order; 'Paired Timestamp' mode gives chA/chB order.

time_interval_mode.command: Mode menu > Time Interval (enter mode item as two characters, e.g. 'A1')
time_interval_mode.notes: Outputs ch1 - ch0 for each pair (may be negative). The exact menu code for Time Interval is not listed in the text (only 'A1' = timestamp mode appears in an example) - read it from the menu on the unit.

enter_config.notes: Any key during the ~5 s startup delay, or '#' at any time; prompt '#>'. Multi-item: 'A1;F C/D;W'. W writes EEPROM (changes lost otherwise).

trigger_slope.notes: Trigger edge per channel (example from manual; R presumably rising - unverified).

comment_lines.notes: All configuration-system output lines have '#' prepended (comments for TimeLab).

binary_mode.notes: 12-byte message: 2 header bytes, 1 byte channel ID, lowest 4 bytes of PICstop, 4 bytes tof; ts_picos = (PICstop * PICTICK_PS) - tof, PICTICK_PS = 10,000,000 default.

poll_mode.notes: If set, outputs only the latest measurement when the poll character is received.

missing: menu item letter/digit codes for each mode (except example A1)
input impedance / trigger level (hardware inputs, not configurable by command)
external 10 MHz reference command (EXT_REF is a hardware input; clock speed setting in Advanced menu)

transport.notes: 'Skydel is listening on port 4820 + id. If Skydel was started with instance id 2, it would be listening on port 4822.' (p.219). HIL client uses TCP for commands plus UDP for position data (HIL Time Reference page). Python lib: skydelsdx; C# lib: Skydel-SDX/API/CSharp/SdxApi; C++: Skydel-SDX/API/Cpp/sdx_api. Only Python strings are quoted in the manual; the manual says C#/C++ syntax differences are minor but gives no C# strings.

connect.notes: connect(ip, instance id); defaults 'localhost' and 0. sim.disconnect() to close.

new_configuration.notes: sim.call blocks; sim.post(cmd) + sim.wait(cmd) is asynchronous.

arm_on_1pps.notes: StartPPS: RF starts at syncDurationMs relative to PPS zero. GetComputerSystemTimeSinceEpochAtPps0() gives PC time at PPS0.

satellite_power_offset.notes: Shown in API-changes appendix (replaces deprecated SetSatellitePower(system, prn, powerOffset, otherSatsFollow)); send as sim.call(SetPowerForSV(...)).

stream_motion_hil.command: sim.call(SetVehicleTrajectory("HIL")) ; sim.call(SetHilTjoin(20)) ; sim.pushEcefNed(elapsedMs, position, attitude, velocity, angularVelocity)
stream_motion_hil.notes: First push must use elapsed time 0.0 (ms since RF start). Manual text writes 'Sim.call(SetHilTjoin(20))' (capital S, typo). Tracks: SetVehicleTrajectory("Track"), beginTrackDefinition()/pushTrackEcef/pushTrackLla/endTrackDefinition().

missing: load_scenario (no command name for opening a saved configuration found in the manual; see Documentation.txt on an installed system)
query_status (simulator-state query command name not given in manual)

manual.title: R&S SMBV100B Satellite Navigation User Manual (SMBVB-K44/-K66/... options) and R&S SMBV100B User Manual (webhelp, base instrument)

transport.notes: Base manual, 'Starting remote control with socket communication': 'The R&S SMBV100B uses the port number 5025 for remote connection via Telnet.' HIL over UDP: [:SOURce<hw>]:BB:GNSS:RECeiver[:V<st>]:HIL:PORT, *RST 7755 (GNSS p.324).

arm_on_trigger.notes: Sequence AUTO | RETRigger | AAUTo | ARETrigger | SINGle; Source INTernal|EGT1|EXTernal|BBSY. Example (p.617): :SOURce1:BB:GNSS:TRIGger:SOURce EGT1 // external trigger at the USER connector; :SOURce1:BB:GNSS:TRIGger:EXTernal:SYNChronize:OUTPut ON. Arm: [:SOURce<hw>]:BB:GNSS:TRIGger:ARM:EXECute; manual: [:SOURce<hw>]:BB:GNSS:TRIGger:EXECute (p.620). Edge of the global trigger input is configured in the base manual (not extracted).

satellite_power_offset.notes: -21 to 0 dB; same for GALileo/GLONass/BEIDou/QZSS/NAVic/SBAS. Reference: [:SOURce<hw>]:BB:GNSS:POWer:REFerence (p.448).

stream_motion_hil.notes: ECEF; ElapsedTime from [:SOURce<hw>]:BB:GNSS:RT:HWTime? (p.324). MODE:B on p.320. Interface: [:SOURce<hw>]:BB:GNSS:RECeiver[:V<st>]:HIL:ITYPe SCPI | UDP (p.324). Requires SMBVB-K109 for UDP.

query_status.notes: Returns STOP | RUN. Also [:SOURce<hw>]:BB:GNSS:SIMulation:INFO? (p.345) and :BB:GNSS:RT:HWTime? elapsed time.

missing: external trigger edge selection for the USER/global trigger input (in base manual, not extracted)
